items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels dislocated his left elbow (same as prior injury), X-rays negative no fracture, ruled out, additional testing Monday; expected to miss time (previously ~1 month).
items.why: Dislocated left elbow on freak play bracing fall; carted off.
items.implication: Miss multiple weeks; Marcus Mariota takes over QB duties. ROS QB downgrade severe.
items.opportunity: Backup QB streaming and Commanders skill players volatility.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) officially active; will wear flak jacket, projected with docks but played (limited volume decoy role early reports).
items.why: Optimism from Rapoport, limited Friday practice, pushed to play.
items.implication: Startable but docked snaps/efficiency; WR2 range with risk.
items.opportunity: If limited, Quentin Johnston/Tre Harris upside.

items.text: Raiders HC on TE Brock Bowers (knee): 'Close, very close. He looks great.' Could return soon (was doubtful W2).
Bears QB Caleb Williams suffered hamstring injury, replaced by Bagent; imaging Monday, walking under own power good spirits.
items.implication: Potential miss time; monitor tests. Bagent fill-in.
items.opportunity: Bears pass catchers (Odunze etc) short-term if limited.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey (hamstring) inactive; grab Jonah Coleman now as beneficiary for looks.
items.why: Hamstring, not expected pregame confirmed inactive.
items.implication: Zero week; stash/handcuff Coleman for role expansion.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow (back) officially active after questionable.
items.why: Back tightness but expected and confirmed active.

items.text: Michael Pittman (foot) OUT; expecting decent look at Germie Bernard (YAC fit).
items.implication: Zero week; Bernard stash/upgrade for targets.

items.text: Chris Olave (hamstring) expected to play/sounds fine, no real docks in projections; confirmed active.
items.implication: Full go WR1/2 without significant limitation.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) true game-time decision (MNF); different from prior psoas.
items.implication: Have pivot ready; if out TE/ other WR heavy.
items.opportunity: If misses, Ferguson/Parkinson or Mumpfield etc.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) OUT; opens door for Rashod Bateman volume.
items.implication: Zero production; Bateman primary beneficiary targets/routes.

items.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba 9/155/3 TDs; 5th WR ever with 8+ catches/120+ yds/TD in each of first two games.
Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) questionable to return; on injury watchlist.
items.implication: Monitor return; possible limited or Gainwell bump.
items.opportunity: Kenny Gainwell handcuff value if limited.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans hip injury Q to return, coach Shanahan says doesn't look serious; Demarcus Robinson high ankle.
items.implication: Likely minor, monitor but not long-term fear.

items.text: Packers WR Jayden Reed (neck/head) ruled out; has feeling/movement all extremities, overnight observation.
items.opportunity: Dontayvion Wicks or Christian Watson volume.
